question:
Choose the one which can be substituted for the given sentence.

A medicine that induces sleep
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4) Hypnotic**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **“Hypnotic”** refers to a medicine or drug that induces sleep. (नींद लाने वाली दवा)

 
 
• **Example:** The doctor prescribed a mild hypnotic to help the patient sleep better at night.
 
 
 
• **Explanation:** “Hypnotic” drugs are used to calm the nervous system and promote sleep. (नींद लाने के लिए प्रयुक्त दवा)
 
 
• **Example:** After several sleepless nights, he was given a hypnotic tablet by his physician.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is: **Hypnotic**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Sedative** (शांत करने वाली दवा): A medicine used to calm a person or make them sleepy but not necessarily induce deep sleep.

 
 
• **Example:** The nurse gave the patient a sedative before the operation to help him relax.
 
 
 
• **Narcotic** (नशीली दवा): A drug that dulls the senses, relieves pain, and can cause sleep; often addictive.
 
 
• **Example:** Morphine is a narcotic used for severe pain relief.
 
 
 
• **Analgesic** (पीड़ा नाशक दवा): A medicine used to relieve pain without causing loss of consciousness.
 
 
• **Example:** Aspirin is a common analgesic used for headaches and body pain.
